tex_content.html:
1. ch5:inner-product\group chapter-5 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0092

An inner product on a real vector space $\V $ is a symmetric bilinear form $(\cdot ,\cdot )$ with $(x,x)>0$ for $x\neq 0$. It induces $\| x\| =(x,x)^{1/2}$ and satisfies 1. ch5:5.7\group chapter-5
